title: Written safety guide: waft, do not sniff hard; no tasting; allergy check
subject: Science
unit: Spring 2: The human body and senses (Memory Box and Human Senses)
source: Seeded from science/y1 lesson 12 (Written safety guide: waft, do not sniff hard; no tasting; allergy check)
intro: Lesson 12: Touch, taste and smell. To understand that we touch with our skin, taste with our tongue and smell with our nose

questions.q: Which body part feels a soft sponge?
questions.model: I touch the sponge with my fingers. Fingers have skin. Skin feels soft and hard. So touch uses skin.

questions.q: Which sense tells you the bread is burning in the next room?
Do the smell test with three pots and record your guesses in the table.
questions.a: Three guesses recorded, for example lemon, cinnamon, mint
questions.model: Teacher shows pot 1 on camera: wafts, says 'fresh and sour', writes 'lemon'.

questions.q: Feely bag: touch two objects and say one word for each.
questions.a: For example: spoon smooth, sponge soft

questions.q: Which sense is missing from our test?
questions.a: Taste (and sight, because our eyes were closed)

questions.q: Big question: could you find an orange with your eyes closed? How?
questions.a: Yes: smell it, feel its bumpy skin, or taste it
